sources.title: Understand each balanced move: original algebra pilot
sources.attribution: Original Paths lesson prose, worked example, exercises, mathematical certificates and misconception feedback. Definitions and conditions were checked against OpenStax, Elementary Algebra 2e, sections 2.1 and 2.2 (accessed 2026-09-10): https://openstax.org/books/elementary-algebra-2e/pages/2-1-solve-equations-using-the-subtraction-and-addition-properties-of-equality and https://openstax.org/books/elementary-algebra-2e/pages/2-2-solve-equations-using-the-division-and-multiplication-properties-of-equality
sources.reuse: Original project material. OpenStax was used as a reference for definitions and equality conditions; no textbook exercises or prose were copied.
